fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Front Driveway; Access Drive; Walkway; Landscaped Area; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Turnaround Space; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders confirm the correct property from the road.
• Mark the access drive entrance clearly so responders can distinguish it from the main driveway on approach.
• Post signage or paint curb markings identifying which parking areas may be used for emergency vehicle staging.
• Keep both access points clear of parked vehicles so responders can enter and exit without repositioning equipment.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive to maintain clearance for emergency vehicles traveling to the detached structure.
• Cut back any shrubs or low branches near the detached structure so responders can move around all sides without obstruction.
• Keep the walkway between the main residence and detached structure clear of stored items so responders can move between both structures quickly.
• Mark or communicate to responders in advance that turnaround space is limited, so apparatus operators can plan approach direction before arrival.
• Keep a clear path between the parking area and the main entrance so responders carrying equipment are not routed around parked vehicles.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Scattered Trees; Open Terrain; Grass Cover; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Single Access Route; Open Green Space
wildfire.recommendations:
• Keep grass mowed short across the open terrain surrounding the structure, particularly during dry months.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure to increase open space between tree canopy and the roofline.
• Trim lower branches on scattered trees close to the structure to reduce the path fire can travel upward into the canopy.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or within a few feet of the structure's walls and foundation.
• Separate shrub clusters near the structure so individual plants are not touching or overlapping.
• Keep the single access route free of overhanging branches and encroaching shrubs along both sides.
• Maintain the open green space by removing any dead or dry grass buildup that accumulates near the structure.
• Move any stored wood, debris, or flammable materials away from the base of the structure and out of the immediate yard area.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is visible to emergency vehicles approaching from the road.
